Slicked-back, short, chestnut-brown hair. Narrow, calculating, amber-gold eyes. Appears in the mid-40s with a flamboyant maturity. Lean build. Wears a white pinstripe suit with a red waistcoat, a red bow tie, and a matching red top hat with a black band. A brown bowler hat and a gold-topped cane are signature accessories.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
